## GDPR and CCPA Compliance

**Last updated: 12 February 2026**

This document explains how the Anacan app complies with the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

### 1. Data Controller

The controller of your data is:
- **Company:** Anacan LLC
- **Address:** Baku, Azerbaijan
- **Email:** info@anacan.az

### 2. Your Rights Under the GDPR (European Union)

#### 2.1. Right to Be Informed (Articles 13-14)
You have the right to know why and how your data is processed and how long it is retained.

#### 2.2. Right of Access (Article 15)
You have the right to receive a free copy of your personal data being processed. You can use the "Data Export" feature in the app.

#### 2.3. Right to Rectification (Article 16)
You can request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.

#### 2.4. Right to Erasure - "Right to Be Forgotten" (Article 17)
You can request the deletion of your data in the following circumstances:
- When the data is no longer needed for the purpose for which it was collected
- When you withdraw your consent
- When you believe the processing is unlawful

#### 2.5. Right to Restriction of Processing (Article 18)
You can request that the processing of your data be restricted in certain circumstances.

#### 2.6. Right to Data Portability (Article 20)
You have the right to receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format and transfer it to another service.

#### 2.7. Right to Object (Article 21)
You can object to the processing of your data, particularly processing for direct marketing purposes.

### 3. Legal Bases for Processing (GDPR Article 6)

We process your data on the following legal bases:
- **Consent (Article 6(1)(a)):** Your explicit consent to the processing of health data
- **Contract (Article 6(1)(b)):** To perform the service contract
- **Legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c)):** Where required by law
- **Legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)):** To improve services and ensure security

### 4. Special Categories of Data

Health data is considered a special category of data under the GDPR. We process this data only on the basis of your explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a)).

### 5. Your Rights Under the CCPA (California)

#### 5.1. Right to Know
You have the right to know the following about personal data collected in the past 12 months:
- Categories of data collected
- Sources of collection
- Purpose of collection
- Third parties with whom it was shared

#### 5.2. Right to Deletion
You can request the deletion of your collected personal data.

#### 5.3. Right to Opt Out of Sale
**We do not sell your personal data.** We do not engage in any activities that fall under the CCPA's definition of "sale."

#### 5.4. Right to Non-Discrimination
You will not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights.

### 6. Data Breach Notification

In accordance with GDPR Article 33, in the event of a data breach:
- Supervisory authorities will be notified within 72 hours
- Users will be notified directly of breaches that pose a high risk

### 7. International Data Transfers

Your data is stored on servers within the European Economic Area. For any transfer, safeguards compliant with GDPR Article 46 (Standard Contractual Clauses) are applied.

### 8. Data Protection Officer (DPO)

For questions about data protection:
- **Email:** info@anacan.az

### 9. Right to Lodge a Complaint

Under GDPR Article 77, if you have concerns about the processing of your data, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority.

### 10. Policy Updates

This document is reviewed regularly and updated when necessary. Users are notified of any changes.

## Disclaimer

**Last updated: 12 February 2026**

This Disclaimer contains important legal information regarding the Anacan mobile application (the "App") and all its services. By using the App, you agree to the following terms.

### 1. General Warning

**This App is not a medical device, medical service, or source of medical advice.** All information provided in the Anacan App, including but not limited to pregnancy tracking, menstrual calendars, nutrition recommendations, exercise programs, and AI-based guidance, is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes.

### 2. Complete Disclaimer of Medical Liability

No information provided in the App:
- Replaces or is intended to replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment
- Creates a doctor-patient relationship
- May be used to assess individual medical conditions
- May serve as a basis for prescribing medication or treatment
- Is a substitute for emergency medical services

**As a user, you agree to always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making any decisions regarding your health.**

### 3. About the AI Advisor (Anacan.AI)

Anacan.AI is an automated assistant based on artificial intelligence technology. The AI Advisor:
- Is not a healthcare professional or doctor
- Is not capable of accurately assessing your individual medical condition
- Provides responses that are general in nature and should not be considered personalized medical advice
- May contain errors, inaccuracies, or outdated information
- Must not be used in medical emergencies

The user assumes full responsibility for any actions taken based on recommendations provided by the AI.

### 4. Health Tracking Tools

The health tracking tools in the App (kick counter, contraction tracker, weight tracker, blood sugar tracker, etc.) are intended solely for personal record-keeping. These tools:
- Are not medical devices and have not been certified as medical devices
- Cannot be used to make a medical diagnosis
- Are not guaranteed to be accurate
- Are not a substitute for a professional medical examination

### 5. Third-Party Content

The App may contain information, articles, recommendations, or links obtained from third-party sources. Anacan:
- Does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of this content
- Is not responsible for the content of third-party websites or services
- Does not endorse third-party products or services

### 6. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Anacan and its management, employees, partners, and agents shall not be liable for:
- Any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use of or inability to use the App
- The consequences of decisions made based on information in the App
- The loss, corruption, or unauthorized access of data
- Service interruptions, delays, or technical malfunctions
- Inaccurate or incomplete guidance provided by the AI

### 7. Medical Emergencies

In any of the following situations, **call 103 (Emergency Medical Services) immediately** or go to the nearest hospital:
- Severe or unusual pain
- Vaginal bleeding
- Dizziness or loss of consciousness
- Shortness of breath
- A sudden decrease in or absence of fetal movement
- Any other concerning symptom

**The App must never be used as a substitute for emergency medical care.**

### 8. Disclaimer of Warranties

The App is provided "as is" and "as available." Anacan makes no express or implied warranties that the App will be uninterrupted, error-free, secure, or suitable for any particular purpose.

### 9. Changes

This Disclaimer may be changed at any time without notice. Continued use of the App after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

### 10. Contact

If you have any questions, please contact us:
- **Email:** info@anacan.az
- **Website:** https://anacan.az

a1b08a0c-00ac-43cb-ac9d-0763b8a8ea29.content:
Data Use Policy

Last updated: 12 February 2026

This document explains in detail how the Anacan app collects, stores, processes, and protects data.

1. Classification of Data Collected

#### 1.1 Account Information

First and last name

Email address

Encrypted password

Profile picture (optional)

Account creation date

#### 1.2 Health and Tracking Data

Menstrual cycle dates, duration, and symptoms

Stage of pregnancy and last menstrual period date

Daily mood, symptoms, and notes

Weight, height, and head circumference measurements (mother and baby)

Food and water intake records

Kick counter and contraction tracker data

Sleep tracking records

Blood glucose measurements

Doctor's appointment records

#### 1.3 Community Data

Shared posts, comments, and reactions

Group memberships

Stories - automatically deleted after 24 hours

#### 1.4 Technical Data

Device identifier (anonymous)

Operating system and version

App version

IP address (for login security)

Push notification tokens

Firebase Analytics identifier

#### 1.5 AI Usage Data

Queries sent to the AI Advisor

Chat history (linked only to the user's account)

2. Data Storage Technology

#### 2.1 Server Infrastructure

Hosting: Supabase platform (on AWS infrastructure)

Location: European Union

Database: PostgreSQL (encrypted)

File storage: Supabase Storage (encrypted)

#### 2.2 Security Measures

All data transfers are protected with TLS 1.3 encryption

Row Level Security (RLS) in the database

JWT-based authentication

Password hashing with Bcrypt

Regular automated backups

DDoS protection

3. Third-Party Services

We use the following third-party services:

| Service | Purpose | Data Shared |

|--------|--------|-------------------|

| Firebase | Push notifications, analytics | Device token, anonymous usage statistics |

| Supabase | Database, authentication | All account information (encrypted) |

| Google AI | AI Advisor | Anonymous query text (without personal data) |

| RevenueCat | Subscription management | Purchase identifier |

A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) has been signed with each third-party service.

4. Data Retention Period

| Data Type | Retention Period |

|-------------|-----------------|

| Account information | While the account remains active |

| Health records | While the account remains active |

| AI chat history | 90 days |

| Community stories | 24 hours |

| Analytics data | 26 months (anonymous) |

| Deleted account | Permanently deleted after 30 days |

| Payment records | For the period required by law (5 years) |

5. Data Export

Users can export their data in the following ways:

In the app: Settings > Data Export (in JSON format)

By email: Send a request to info@anacan.az (response within 10 business days)

6. Data Deletion

#### 6.1 Automatic Deletion

When an account is deleted, all personal data is permanently deleted within 30 days

Community stories are automatically deleted after 24 hours

#### 6.2 Manual Deletion

In the app: Settings > Delete Account

Email: Send a written request to info@anacan.az

#### 6.3 Retained Data

Due to legal obligations, the following may be retained after deletion:

Payment history (as required by tax law)

Information related to legal disputes

7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

The app does not use browser-based cookies. However:

Anonymous usage statistics are collected through Firebase Analytics

This data is not used to identify individual users

Analytics data is used only in aggregate form to improve service quality

8. Data Breach Protocol

In the event of a data breach:

The breach is assessed by the internal team within 24 hours

Users are notified of high-risk breaches within 72 hours

The relevant supervisory authorities are notified

Corrective measures are implemented immediately

9. Contact

For questions about the use of data:

Email: info@anacan.az

Website: https://anacan.az

Response time: 5 business days

1424f7b0-c971-44b8-9106-31e0ce72a5b9.content:
## Refund Policy

**Last updated: February 12, 2026**

This Refund Policy applies to the paid services of the Anacan app (Premium subscription).

### 1. Payment Platforms

Payments for Anacan Premium subscriptions are processed through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Payments are subject to the policies of the relevant platform (Apple or Google).

### 2. Free Trial Period

2.1. Users subscribing to Premium for the first time may be offered a free trial period.

2.2. If you cancel your subscription during the trial period, you will not be charged.

2.3. After the trial period ends, the subscription automatically converts to a paid plan. To prevent this, you must cancel at least 24 hours before the trial period ends.

### 3. Cancelling Your Subscription

3.1. You may cancel your subscription at any time. After cancellation, you can continue using Premium features until the end of the current billing period.

3.2. To cancel:
- **iOS:** Device Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions > Anacan > Cancel
- **Android:** Google Play Store > Subscriptions > Anacan > Cancel
- **In the app:** Profile > My Subscription > Cancel

3.3. Please note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscription automatically.

### 4. Refund Terms

4.1. **App Store (iOS):** Apple's refund policy applies. Refund requests must be submitted directly to Apple: https://reportaproblem.apple.com

4.2. **Google Play (Android):** Google Play's refund policy applies. Refund requests must be submitted through Google Play.

4.3. **Direct request:** If your issue cannot be resolved through the channels above, you may contact info@anacan.az. Each request is reviewed individually.

### 5. Cases Where Refunds Are Not Available

Refunds are not provided in the following cases:
- The user has actively used the services during the subscription period
- The user's account has been suspended for violating the Terms of Use
- More than half of the billing period has elapsed (subject to platform policies)
- The subscription was not cancelled in time after the free trial period ended

### 6. Price Changes

6.1. The Company reserves the right to change subscription prices.

6.2. At least 30 days' notice will be provided regarding price changes.

6.3. New prices will apply only from the next renewal period.

### 7. Contact

For questions regarding refunds:
- **Email:** info@anacan.az
- **Website:** https://anacan.az
- **Response time:** 3-5 business days
